title: docs(cli): separate what each doc naming lint rests on in collect-docs' header
body:
Fixes #19359

Clause-②: no

`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`'s module header gave the **retired** ADR-0048 claim as the live reason for the doc naming lints:

> **Lint**: namespace-prefix naming (doc uniqueness is logical — the metadata registry key carries no package coordinate, so a **bare-name collision silently overwrites across packages**)

That sentence is ADR-0048 §1.1 *context*. The same ADR's §3.3/§3.4 overturned it: §1.2 is headed *"The silence is in the read, not the write"* (the write is already composite-keyed, `packageId:name`), and §3.4 states *"The cross-package **throw is retired**; two distinct packages coexist on the same bare name by construction."* `lintDocNamesAcrossOwners`, 900 lines below in the same file, already declined that sentence by name (#19248) — the correction just never reached the top of the file.

## The judgement: one sentence was justifying TWO rules

Carrying the line-929 correction up verbatim would have been the wrong move. It was written about `docs/duplicate-name`; the header sentence also justifies `docs/namespace-prefix` (and `docs/namespace-required`), which nobody had examined. Re-stating one rule's reason for a second, unexamined rule is the same failure this card is about, one level up.

**What `docs/namespace-prefix` actually rests on — read, not assumed:**

- **The prefix is declared by the spec, not by a collision story.** `DocSchema.name`'s own `.describe()` reads *"Unique doc name; MUST carry the package namespace prefix (enforced by build/publish lint)"* (ADR-0046 §3.1), and §3.2 requires `manifest.namespace` of any package that ships docs.
- **It is load-bearing inside this very module.** A doc link is `[text](./NAME.md)` — a bare name with nowhere to put a package coordinate, flat on purpose so an editor or a GitHub preview resolves it natively (ADR-0046 §3.3: *"Because names are globally unique, this resolves the same way everywhere"*, and *"This check is trivial because the namespace is flat"*). `lintDocs` keys on that prefix, at exactly one line, to split a same-package link — which it resolves here — from a cross-package one, which it defers to publish.
- **ADR-0048 never touched that.** §3.3 repaired metadata reads by ADDING a package-id argument to `getItem(type, name, currentPackageId?)`. The Markdown link form has nowhere to put such an argument, so nothing §3.4 retired was ever load-bearing for this rule.

So the corrected reason does **not** cover both rules, and the header now distinguishes them instead of smuggling one under the other:

- `docs/duplicate-name` — authoring hygiene, the class ADR-0048 §3.4 keeps by name. The header points at `lintDocNamesAcrossOwners` rather than restating it; a second copy of a justification is how the first one went stale.
- `docs/namespace-prefix` / `docs/namespace-required` — the flat link namespace, attributed to ADR-0046 §3.1/§3.3 and to the link split in this module.

No behaviour change. No rule, message, severity or accept set moves; the only edited bytes are comment bytes.

## One edit outside the declared file surface — declared, not silent

The order fenced this work to the module header docblock, "stop and report on a breach". One paragraph **outside** the header was edited, because the header edit made it false. `lintDocNamesAcrossOwners`'s docblock ended with:

> "this module's older framing" above is not gone — it is still live in this file's HEADER docblock, which states the retired claim as the current reason for the naming lints.

After this PR that is untrue. Leaving a newly-false claim in the file to respect a fence would have manufactured the exact defect this card exists to remove, so the paragraph is now in the past tense with a pointer to this card. That five-line paragraph is the whole of the out-of-surface edit — same file, comment-only. Flagged here for the reviewer to accept or to ask me to revert.

## Changeset — measured, not inherited

`patch` on `@objectstack/cli`. Not `skip-changeset`, and re-measured on this branch's own rebuilt artifact rather than taken from #19248:

- `files[]` is `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`; the build is plain `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`; `removeComments` appears nowhere in the package or the root configs — so comments are emitted.
- `npm pack --dry-run` lists `dist/utils/collect-docs.js` (50.5 kB) among 537 shipped files.
- In `dist`: the new clause is present (1 occurrence); the old bullet spelling is absent (0); the retired phrase now occurs exactly once, inside the quotation that declines it.
- `dist/**/*.d.ts` carries 0 occurrences — the block sits above the imports, not on an exported symbol. The published JS bytes move while the declaration surface does not, which is why `Clause-②` is `no`.

## Verification, at `4e5b27ed0a`

| what | result |
|:--|:--|
| `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli --concurrency=2` | 57/57 tasks, exit 0 |
| `vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` (`@objectstack/cli`) | 220 files / 3114 tests passed, exit 0 |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` | exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck` OK) |
| `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derived families | 54 derived, **54 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**, every recorded exit code 0 |
| `eslint . --no-inline-config` (whole repo, not narrowed) | 6945 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, exit 0 |

`packages/cli`'s `integration` tier is declared to CI: the diff touches no integration-layer file, no `bin/` entry and no `test/helpers/serve-process.ts`, so `vitest-tiers.ts` reclassifies nothing here.

Two gates first returned exit **3** — `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` — which both spell that as `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (unbuilt `dist/` in this worktree), not as a finding. Both were re-run green after building the packages each gate named, and the table above is the post-rebuild reading.

## Acceptance notes

- **noted, not filed** — ADR-0046 §3.2 is the upstream source of the retired sentence and still carries it verbatim (*"two packages shipping the same bare name silently overwrite each other (last-write-wins)"*) with no amendment pointing at ADR-0048 §3.3/§3.4. ADR-0048 is later and supersedes on the point, but the older text is what regenerated this claim into this file and into `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` (#19358). Tier H, `docs/adr/**`, out of this lane and this round. Dedupe words: `ADR-0046 §3.2 last-write-wins` · `silently overwrite each other` · `ADR-0048 §3.4 supersession not annotated`. Carrier: whoever lands #19358 reads the same source.
- **noted, not filed** — the standing severity question is unchanged by this PR and is already recorded under #19248 in `lintDocNamesAcrossOwners`' own docblock: ADR-0048 §3.4 hands authoring hygiene to a warning-only lint (`os lint`'s `naming/namespace-prefix` carries `severity: 'warning'`) while `docs/duplicate-name` and `docs/namespace-prefix` are `severity: 'error'`. Not re-filed here.
- No other stale justification in the file was swept or edited.
- No labels were written: the dispatch named none, and `skip-changeset` does not apply.
